senses.gloss:
ता(ट)डका
—1 N. of a female fiend, daughter of Suketu, wife of Sunda and mother
 of Mārīcha. [She was changed into a fiend by the sage Agastya whose devotions
 she had disturbed. She was killed by Rāma when she began to disturb,
 the sacrificial rites of Viśvāmitra. Rāma was first unwilling to bend
 his bow, against a woman, but the sage overcame his scruples. See R. 11. 20].
—2 The large dark-green pumpkin.
